dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hee-hee! One has witnessed how you have poured your heart and soul into the pursuit of the heavens and Abyssal Moon.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Travelers, their appetite for adventure insatiable... Surely do they leave the most brilliant marks upon this paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein means that she enjoys the style of adventurer camps. She never grows tired of it.
